name: Homo Fluxus (meta-principle)
title: Homo Fluxus — Meta-layer theoretical reference
description: Curated meta-layer reference for Homo Fluxus: humans (and any living system) treated as dynamic energy-flow processes rather than static entities, embedded in gradients of matter, energy, information, and meaning. Aligns the EFC formalism (reflection coefficient R, critical threshold R_c ≈ 1/e) with the wider non-equilibrium thermodynamics-of-life tradition (Schrödinger, Prigogine, Kauffman, Schneider & Sagan, England, Friston, Deacon, Levin). Includes HF1–HF5 sealed predictions and bridges to cognitive, medicine, and society/AI-alignment layers.

key_equation.name: Interior reflection coefficient
key_equation.description: Dimensionless ratio of energy-weighted internal reflection time to system-wide leakage time; crossing R_c ≈ 1/e ≈ 0.37 marks the onset of self-modelling — the transition from flow object to flow subject (Homo Fluxus proper).

sealed_predictions.statement: Cross-modal coherence proxies (Φ̇I, C_phase, I_body) load on a single low-dimensional latent factor.
Higher coherence-potential agents display stronger systemic empathy.
Field-aware RL policies reduce externalised entropy at equal or lower energetic cost vs. locally-optimal policies.
Local connectome metrics (degree ratio) predict κ with |r| > 0.8; global metrics (λ_2) fail.
Targeted modulation of local degree ratio causally shifts κ in the HF4-predicted direction.
